brief: A new song about riding the night bus home, in the spirit of the reference song but with its own words and images.
referenceLyrics:
[Verse 1]
The last bus home is running late again,
I count the puddles shining in the rain,
the driver nods like he's seen me before,
I take the seat beside the folding door.

[Chorus]
Last bus home, last bus home,
through the city on my own,
every window tells a story,
on the last bus home.

[Verse 2]
A nurse is sleeping in her hospital blue,
a boy is writing words he can't say to you,
the street lights flicker past us one by one,
and none of us can say where the night has gone.

[Chorus]
Last bus home, last bus home,
through the city on my own,
every window tells a story,
on the last bus home.
title: Night Bus
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The night bus home is running late once more,
I count the puddles shining on the floor,
the driver nods like he's seen me before,
I take the seat beside the sliding door.

[Chorus]
Night bus home, night bus home,
through the city all alone,
every window tells a story,
on the night bus home.

[Verse 2]
A nurse is dozing in her hospital blue,
a kid is writing words he can't say to you,
the street lamps flicker past us one by one,
and none of us can tell where the night has gone.

[Chorus]
Night bus home, night bus home,
through the city all alone,
every window tells a story,
on the night bus home.
reason: Close paraphrase of the reference: same lines and images, about 30% of the words swapped.
